description: This file is a Perl script used for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images, including reading, writing, parsing, and constructing firmware partitions, as well as handling various firmware components such as RedBoot, Kernel, Ramdisk, and others. It contains functions for padding, parsing partition tables, creating partition entries, and assembling or disassembling firmware images.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads the input data with 0xff bytes up to the total specified length.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block size greater than or equal to the input length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold a given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary packed partition entry including name, address, size, and optional skip regions.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition entry to extract name, address, size, and skip regions.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Searches in firmware data buffer for the partition table starting with the 'RedBoot' signature.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses the partition table buffer into an array of partition metadata.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 block with a specific header.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes binary data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Constructs trailer data with product, protocol, firmware version info, currently not used.

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints the contents of the RedBoot trailer, parsing specific header fields.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the 'Loader' partition and adjusts the 'Kernel' and 'Ramdisk' partitions to fixed offsets.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Populates partition metadata with data extracted from a firmware buffer, parsing the partition table if present.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Generates the binary partition table data from partition metadata.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Constructs a firmware image buffer from partitions and writes it to a file.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Sanity check of the partition table data, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints a human-readable list of partition metadata.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Provides a default set of partitions for firmware manipulation.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Assigns start addresses and sizes to partitions based on firmware layout constraints.
